value.name: rex tries to enter house
value.description: Rex attempts to unlock and enter his house but finds the key does not work.
evidence:
Rex is trying his key in the front door of his house. Finding
it doesn't, work he rattles the knob, then leans on the
doorbell.

value.name: rex calls for marylin
value.description: Rex calls out to Marylin from outside the house, trying to get her attention.

value.name: marylin refuses door conversation
value.description: Marylin answers through the intercom and tells Rex to get away from the door.
evidence:
Finally, through the intercom:
MARYLIN
Rex. Get away from the door.

value.name: rex pleads for civilized discussion
value.description: Rex asks Marylin to talk calmly about their situation instead of shutting him out.
evidence:
REX
Look, Marylin, can't we have a
civilized discussion about this?

value.name: marylin ends the argument
value.description: Marylin says they are already having a civilized discussion and that it is winding down.
evidence:
MARYLIN
We are. And it's winding down.

value.name: rex warns divorce would ruin him
value.description: Rex argues that a divorce would destroy him financially because everything is tied to his business.
evidence:
REX
But Marylin, you know a divorce would
ruin me right now. Everything I have --
everything we have -- is tied up in
my business. The business is my entire
life.

value.name: marylin mocks rex's business claim
value.description: Marylin sarcastically references the Atcheson, Topeka and the Santa Fe to undercut Rex's plea.
evidence:
MARYLIN
Are you forgetting about the Atcheson,
Topeka and the Santa Fe?

value.name: marylin threatens to unleash dogs
value.description: Marylin tells Rex to leave and warns that she will sic the dogs on him if necessary.
evidence:
MARYLIN
Rex. Go away. I don't want to have
to sic the dogs on you.

value.name: dogs bark menacingly
value.description: Rex hears large dogs barking from inside the house, confirming Marylin's threat.
evidence:
From inside the house we hear the menacing sound of LARGE
DOGS BARKING.

value.name: scene reveals law office waiting room
value.description: The setting shifts to a law firm's waiting room, revealing Rex is actually waiting at Massey, Meyerson, Sloan & Guralnick.
evidence:
LETTERING
On an interior wall; it says MASSEY, MEYERSON, SLOAN &
GURALNICK.
A pull back shows that we are in a waiting room
value.location_hint: Massey, Meyerson, Sloan & Guralnick waiting room

value.name: receptionist reassures rex
value.description: A receptionist tells Rex that Mr. Massey will see him shortly.
evidence:
RECEPTIONIST
Mr. Massey will be right with you.
value.location_hint: Massey, Meyerson, Sloan & Guralnick waiting room
